$comment: Teenage Engineering 'TE SysEx' vocabulary as used by TE's own web apps (update utility, EP sample tool), re-derived by us from their public JavaScript on 2026-09-26. OP-XY support per command is UNVERIFIED unless noted. Safety classes are our policy, not TE's. See docs/research/60-firmware.md.
sources: docs/research/90-device-probe.md (identity reply of the owner's OP-XY)

opxy.identity_version_bytes: zero on OS 1.1.33 (use GREET os_version instead)

decode.device_id: reply[2] (used as byte 4 of every TE SysEx frame to this device)

identity.updater_retry: 10 tries, 500 ms apart (5 s total) per new MIDI output port

frame.debug_log_frame: F0 00 20 76 <device_id> 33 <ASCII log text> F7 (device firmware log line; EP community: stop all traffic when these appear)
frame.request_id: 12-bit, per output port; TE starts at random 0..4094 and increments mod 4096
frame.status_byte: responses only; sits OUTSIDE the packed7 payload
frame.unsolicited: frames without BIT_REQUEST_ID_AVAILABLE are events (e.g. EP FILE events)

packed7.description: groups of up to 7 raw bytes -> 1 flag byte + 7 data bytes; flag bit i = high bit of raw byte i (bit 0 = first byte)

status.>=64: command-specific success / in progress (request stays open, timeout re-armed)

commands.name: GREET
commands.response: ASCII 'key:value;key:value;...' with keys chip_id, mode (normal|bootloader|test), os_version, product, serial, sku, sw_version, base_sku
commands.used_by: update utility on every device detection
commands.safety: read-only (candidate first probe; needs owner approval before first use)
commands.opxy_support: expected (OP-XY is a listed update-utility device) but not yet observed by us

commands.name: DFU
commands.safety: FORBIDDEN - firmware update / reboot to bootloader. Block at the transport layer.

subcommands.1: ENTER: [01, 01 (ENTER_MIDI), 00, C8] reboots into TE Boot in MIDI-DFU mode
subcommands.2: BEGIN: [02, version(8, BE16x4), B0 (BEGIN_APP=176), sku(4, BE), size(4, BE = file length - 64), firmware_type(1)]; response bytes 0-1 = device max message size (BE)
subcommands.3: CHUNK: [03, chunk_no % 256, raw bytes of file[64:] ...]; chunk = ceil(max_msg * 7/8) - 12 (default 235)
subcommands.4: PERFORM: [04]; progress replies (status >= 64): data[0] = percent, ASCII '[step]' after it
subcommands.5: EXIT: [05]; reply data[0] * 3 = seconds to wait for reboot (default 60)

commands.notes: If BEGIN is rejected with status 3 (bad request) the updater reboots the unit into TE Boot with ENTER, waits for it to re-appear with mode:bootloader, then retries BEGIN. A BEGIN reply whose first byte is 0x40 is logged as 'performing update in app'.

commands.name: FILE
commands.safety: LIST/GET/INFO/METADATA_GET are read-only; PUT/DELETE/METADATA_SET/MOVE/PLAYBACK change state (owner approval, backups first)
commands.opxy_support: unknown - the OP-XY uses MTP for files; only EP-series use is documented

subcommands.1: INIT: [01, flags (1 = subscribe to events), max_response_len u32]; response: [?, chunk_size u32]
subcommands.2: PUT: [02, 00, flags, file_id u16, parent_id u16, size u32, name, 00] then [02, 01, page u16, data...]; empty page = EOF
subcommands.3: GET: [03, 00, file_id u16, offset u32] then [03, 01, page u16]; open response: [file_id u16, flags, size u32, name, 00]
subcommands.4: LIST: [04, page u16, node_id u16]; response: [page u16] + repeated [node_id u16, flags u8, size u32, name, 00]
subcommands.5: PLAYBACK: [05, action (1 start, 2 stop), file_id u16, offset u32, length u32]
subcommands.7: METADATA: [07, 01 SET, file_id u16, json, 00] | [07, 02 GET, file_id u16, page u16, key?, 00] | [07, 04 SET_PAGED, 00 init | 01 data, ...]
subcommands.11: INFO: [0B, file_id u16]; response [node_id u16, parent_id u16, flags u8, size u32, name, 00]
subcommands.12: MOVE: [0C, file_id u16, parent_id u16, new_file_id u16]

commands.name: SETTINGS

subcommands.1: INIT: [01, 03, E8] (1000); status 0 means the device supports settings (update utility then shows a 'settings' panel)
subcommands.2: GET_ALL: [02, page u16]; each reply: 2 bytes then NUL-terminated JSON text; concatenate pages until an empty one; JSON = {settings:[{desc, settings:[{id, desc, value, range?:{min,max,step}, choices?}]}]}
subcommands.3: SET: [03, id u16, JSON-encoded value as ASCII, 00]

commands.safety: INIT/GET_ALL read-only in intent (INIT is sent automatically by the update utility); SET changes device settings -> owner approval
commands.opxy_support: unknown - high-value to test (would expose device settings as typed JSON)

commands.name: PRODUCT_SPECIFIC
commands.notes: defined in TE's client library, unused by both web apps
